settings.title: Line
settings.intro: Keeps what you copied last on a rope stretched across the screen. Click a card to copy it, or drag it out to drop it where you want.
settings.enableHint: When off, the line never opens.
settings.edgeReveal: Show at the edge of the screen
settings.edgeRevealHint: Move the pointer to the screen edge and the line appears.
settings.peekOnCopyHint: The line shows for a moment when you copy something new. It never takes focus from the app you are typing in.
settings.breezeHint: While the line is open the cards sway now and then. Off when reduce motion is on.
settings.hotkeyHint: Opens the line and gives it focus. Esc closes it.
settings.conflict: Another app already uses this shortcut, or Windows reserves it. Choose a different one.
settings.showNowHint: Open the line now to see how it looks.
settings.clipboardOff: Clipboard history is off, so the line stays empty. You can turn it on in Clipboard settings.
settings.zoomHint: Rest on an image for a moment to see it twice as large.
settings.soundHint: A soft click when a card lands on the rope. Off while Reduce motion is on.
settings.hotkeySearchHint: Opens the line with the search field focused. Typing filters every rope.
settings.hotkeyCaptureHint: Hangs the screen under the cursor on the line as an image. Suggestion: Ctrl+Alt+A
settings.hotkeyCopyLatestHint: Copies the newest image on the line to the clipboard.
settings.sagHint: How far the rope hangs down in the middle.
settings.cardShadowHint: A soft shadow under each card.
settings.labelsHint: A small name at the left end of each rope.
settings.numbersHint: Shows 1 to 9 on the first cards of a rope. The same keys pick them.
settings.maxPerRopeHint: Automatic fits as many as the screen allows. Others are limited to the number you pick.
settings.edgeHint: The ropes hang from the top or rise from the bottom of the screen.
settings.revealDwellHint: How long the pointer rests on the edge before the line opens.
settings.hideDelayHint: How long the line waits after the pointer leaves.
settings.clickPaste: Pastes it into the last app
settings.fallHint: New cards drop onto the rope.
settings.reduceNote: Reduce motion in Appearance turns all of this off.
settings.resetHint: Puts every look and behaviour setting back to its default. The on/off switch and shortcuts stay.
settings.resetDone: The line is back to its defaults
